description: Generate a personalised Mirabello briefing: given a client profile (nationality, budget, family, goals), returns a ranked shortlist with full family cost math AND a shareable branded briefing page URL (valid 90 days). Optionally registers the client for specialist follow-up (email + consent): that sends a follow-up request to Mirabello. Each call creates a new briefing link, and with email + consent repeating the call sends another request.

children_16plus.description: Number of dependent children aged 16 or over — usually priced higher than under-16s.

children_under16.description: Number of dependent children aged under 16 — priced separately by most Caribbean programmes.

email.description: optional — to register for specialist follow-up

mobility_priority.description: True when visa-free travel is the applicant's main objective.

programme_ids.description: optional: specific programmes to brief on (max 3) instead of auto-shortlist

tax_goal.description: True when the applicant's main objective is a tax outcome rather than mobility.

timeline_max_months.description: Maximum acceptable time to the outcome, in MONTHS.

type.description: citizenship or residency preference (omit for both)

name: generate_briefing

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Generate Personalised Briefing
